description: This file defines the PEAR_Command_Common class, a base class for PEAR command-line operations, including methods for retrieving commands, shortcuts, options, help messages, and executing commands.

classes.name: PEAR_Command_Common
classes.description: A base class for PEAR command-line commands, providing common functionality such as command retrieval, help, and execution.

methods.name: getCommands
methods.description: Returns a list of all commands defined by this class.

methods.name: getShortcuts
methods.description: Returns a list of all command shortcuts.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for a specified command.

methods.name: getGetoptArgs
methods.description: Generates getopt arguments for a command.

methods.name: getHelp
methods.description: Provides help message for a command.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a command with given options and parameters.
